title: Boosting elemental mercury capture via an iodine-mediated pathway over a ternary BiOI-MnOx-TiO2 catalyst
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,6800-6808
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09048B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wenju Li, Dan Peng, Anchao Zhang
A ternary BiOI-MnOx-TiO2 catalyst enables efficient capture of Hg0 via an iodine-mediated pathway, achieving 97% of Hg0 removal efficiency over 50–200 °C with strong SO2 and NO resistance.
